progress_note.text: Patient became hypotensive overnight with a falling hematocrit and increasing abdominal distention. CT showed a large pelvic hematoma. Patient taken back urgently.

index_surgery_op_note: Elective open sigmoid colectomy for diverticular stricture. Anastomosis hand-sewn. Hemostasis confirmed at closure. No drains placed.
current_surgery_op_note: Taken back to the OR emergently on postoperative day 2 for evacuation of an expanding pelvic hematoma. A bleeding mesenteric vessel was identified and ligated. No anastomotic compromise.
evidence: 'Taken back to the OR emergently on postoperative day 2 for evacuation of an expanding pelvic hematoma' — unplanned, related complication within 30 days (Rule 1.2).

patient_timeline.event: Index surgery: exploratory laparotomy for trauma, abdomen left open
Planned second-look washout and fascial closure

progress_note.text: Damage-control laparotomy. Abdomen intentionally left open with a temporary closure. Plan for second-look in 48 hours.

index_surgery_op_note: Damage-control laparotomy for splenic injury. Spleen removed. Abdomen left open with negative-pressure temporary closure; planned return to OR in 48 hours for second-look washout and delayed fascial closure.
current_surgery_procedure_desc: Abdominal washout and delayed primary fascial closure
current_surgery_op_note: Returned to the OR as planned on postoperative day 2 for washout. No new bleeding. Fascia closed primarily.
evidence: 'planned return to OR in 48 hours for second-look washout and delayed fascial closure' — the return was staged at the index surgery (Rule 1.1 overrides timing).

progress_note.text: New onset right lower quadrant pain and fever. CT consistent with acute appendicitis. Unrelated to recent orthopedic surgery.

index_surgery_op_note: Elective right total knee arthroplasty for osteoarthritis. Uncomplicated. Wound closed in layers.
current_surgery_op_note: Indication: acute appendicitis. Laparoscopic appendectomy performed without complication. No relation to the recent knee procedure.
evidence: 'Indication: acute appendicitis' — different anatomy and a new, unrelated diagnosis (Rule 1.3).

progress_note.text: Postoperative day 6 with peritonitis and feculent drain output. Imaging confirms anastomotic leak. To OR for washout and diversion.

index_surgery_op_note: Elective low anterior resection for rectal cancer. Stapled colorectal anastomosis, air-leak test negative at the time of surgery.
current_surgery_procedure_desc: Exploratory laparotomy, washout, diverting loop ileostomy
current_surgery_op_note: Returned to the operating room on postoperative day 6 for an anastomotic leak with gross peritoneal contamination. Abdomen washed out and a diverting loop ileostomy created.
evidence: 'Returned to the operating room on postoperative day 6 for an anastomotic leak' — unplanned, related complication within 30 days (Rule 1.2).

patient_timeline.event: Index surgery: ventral hernia repair with mesh

progress_note.text: Six weeks out from hernia repair, presenting with a chronic draining sinus. Imaging suggests mesh infection. Plan for mesh explant.

index_surgery_procedure_desc: Open ventral hernia repair with mesh
index_surgery_op_note: Open ventral hernia repair with synthetic mesh. Closed primarily over the mesh.
current_surgery_op_note: Returned to the OR on postoperative day 41 for an infected mesh. Mesh explanted and wound debrided.
evidence: 'Returned to the OR on postoperative day 41' — more than 30 days after the index surgery (Rule 1.4).

patient_timeline.event: Index surgery: exploratory laparotomy, fascia closed
Bedside re-exploration in ICU for dehiscence

progress_note.text: Fascial dehiscence with evisceration at the bedside. Patient too unstable to transport. Re-exploration performed in the ICU.

index_surgery_op_note: Exploratory laparotomy for small-bowel obstruction. Adhesiolysis performed. Fascia closed primarily.
current_surgery_op_note: Acute fascial dehiscence on postoperative day 4. Given hemodynamic instability, re-exploration and temporary abdominal closure were performed at the bedside in the surgical ICU, not in an operating room.
evidence: 're-exploration and temporary abdominal closure were performed at the bedside in the surgical ICU, not in an operating room' — not an operating room (Rule 2).

progress_note.text: High chest-tube output overnight with tamponade physiology. Emergent re-exploration.

index_surgery_op_note: Three-vessel coronary artery bypass grafting on cardiopulmonary bypass. Hemostasis adequate, chest closed in standard fashion.
current_surgery_op_note: Emergent return to the OR on postoperative day 1 for mediastinal bleeding and tamponade. A bleeding branch of the internal mammary harvest bed was controlled.
evidence: 'Emergent return to the OR on postoperative day 1 for mediastinal bleeding and tamponade' — unplanned, related complication within 30 days (Rule 1.2).

patient_timeline.event: Index surgery: free flap breast reconstruction

progress_note.text: Flap checks show worsening venous congestion. Concern for venous thrombosis at the anastomosis. To OR for exploration.

index_surgery_op_note: DIEP free flap reconstruction with microvascular anastomosis. Flap well perfused at the end of the case.
current_surgery_op_note: Taken back to the operating room on postoperative day 1 for venous congestion of the flap. Venous thrombosis identified and the anastomosis revised; flap salvaged.
evidence: 'Taken back to the operating room on postoperative day 1 for venous congestion of the flap' — unplanned, related complication within 30 days (Rule 1.2).

patient_timeline.event: Index surgery: open AAA repair, abdomen left open

progress_note.text: Abdomen left open after a long aortic case for concern of abdominal compartment syndrome. Scheduled to return for closure once edema resolves.

index_surgery_op_note: Open AAA repair with a tube graft. Given prolonged cross-clamp time and bowel edema, the abdomen was deliberately left open with a temporary closure; return to OR scheduled for delayed fascial closure.
current_surgery_op_note: Returned to the OR on postoperative day 2 for the scheduled delayed fascial closure. No bleeding. Fascia approximated.
evidence: 'return to OR scheduled for delayed fascial closure' — the return was planned at the index surgery (Rule 1.1).

patient_timeline.event: ERCP in endoscopy suite for retained stone

progress_note.text: Rising bilirubin and a dilated duct on ultrasound. Retained common bile duct stone suspected. ERCP planned.

index_surgery_op_note: Laparoscopic cholecystectomy for symptomatic cholelithiasis. Critical view of safety obtained. Cholangiogram not performed.
current_surgery_op_note: ERCP performed in the endoscopy suite on postoperative day 3 for a retained common bile duct stone. Stone extracted; sphincterotomy performed. Procedure not performed in an operating room.
evidence: 'ERCP performed in the endoscopy suite ... Procedure not performed in an operating room' — not an operating room (Rule 2).

patient_timeline.event: Index surgery: open reduction internal fixation, ankle
Irrigation and debridement for deep infection

progress_note.text: Wound erythema, drainage, and fever twelve days after ankle fixation. Deep surgical-site infection. To OR for washout and possible hardware retention.

index_surgery_op_note: Open reduction and internal fixation of a bimalleolar ankle fracture. Plates and screws applied. Wound closed in layers.
current_surgery_procedure_desc: Irrigation and debridement of the surgical site
current_surgery_op_note: Returned to the operating room on postoperative day 12 for a deep surgical-site infection at the ankle incision. Irrigation and debridement performed; hardware retained.
evidence: 'Returned to the operating room on postoperative day 12 for a deep surgical-site infection' — unplanned, related complication within 30 days (Rule 1.2).

progress_note.text: Hours after thyroidectomy the patient developed neck swelling and stridor. Expanding neck hematoma. Emergent evacuation.

index_surgery_op_note: Total thyroidectomy for multinodular goiter. Hemostasis confirmed; a drain was placed before closure.
current_surgery_op_note: Taken back to the OR the same day for an expanding neck hematoma with airway compromise. Hematoma evacuated and a small bleeding vessel cauterized.
evidence: 'Taken back to the OR the same day for an expanding neck hematoma' — unplanned, related complication within 30 days (Rule 1.2).

patient_timeline.event: Staged temporary closure planned at index
Planned return for anastomosis and closure

progress_note.text: Bowel left in discontinuity after resection given borderline perfusion; deliberate plan to reassess and complete the anastomosis at a staged return.

index_surgery_op_note: Right hemicolectomy for an obstructing mass. Due to borderline bowel perfusion, the bowel was left in discontinuity and the abdomen temporarily closed; a staged return to the OR was planned to complete the anastomosis and close the fascia.
current_surgery_procedure_desc: Completion of anastomosis and abdominal closure
current_surgery_op_note: Returned to the OR on postoperative day 3 as planned. Bowel viable. Anastomosis completed and fascia closed. Although this was within 30 days, it was a staged, pre-planned return.
evidence: 'a staged return to the OR was planned to complete the anastomosis' — planned at the index surgery, so Rule 1.1 overrides the within-30-day timing.

progress_note.text: Incisional dehiscence with CSF leak five days after laminectomy. To OR for dural repair and re-closure.

index_surgery_op_note: Lumbar laminectomy for spinal stenosis. Dura intact at closure. Wound closed in layers.
current_surgery_op_note: Returned to the operating room on postoperative day 5 for wound dehiscence and a cerebrospinal fluid leak. The dura was repaired and the wound re-closed.
evidence: 'Returned to the operating room on postoperative day 5 for wound dehiscence and a cerebrospinal fluid leak' — unplanned, related complication within 30 days (Rule 1.2).

progress_note.text: Surveillance imaging found a new suspicious lesion in the contralateral breast. Excisional biopsy scheduled. Unrelated to the prior mastectomy site.

index_surgery_op_note: Left simple mastectomy for invasive ductal carcinoma. Wound closed over a drain.
current_surgery_op_note: Excisional biopsy of a new right breast lesion on postoperative day 18. This addresses a new, separate finding and is unrelated to the left mastectomy.
evidence: 'This addresses a new, separate finding and is unrelated to the left mastectomy' — different site and new diagnosis (Rule 1.3).

patient_timeline.event: Index surgery: drainage of intra-abdominal abscess via laparotomy
IR drain placement for residual collection

progress_note.text: Residual pelvic collection on CT. Percutaneous drain placed in IR. No need to return to the operating room.

index_surgery_op_note: Exploratory laparotomy with drainage of an intra-abdominal abscess. Cavity irrigated; a drain left in place.
current_surgery_op_note: A residual pelvic collection was drained percutaneously in interventional radiology on postoperative day 7. This was not an operating-room procedure.
evidence: 'drained percutaneously in interventional radiology ... This was not an operating-room procedure' — not an operating room (Rule 2).
